title: WeMeetAI
tagline: Web3 people struggle to recall contacts and follow up on chats — WeMeetAI will make sure you dont
description:
Attendees at conferences and events often struggle to manage the flood of new connections and conversations. With so many chat threads across different platforms, it’s easy to lose track of who you met, what was discussed, and which conversations require follow-up. This leads to confusion, missed opportunities, and a sense of overwhelm as important details slip through the cracks.

Key concerns:

    Losing track of important contacts
    Forgetting key discussion points
    Overwhelm from scattered, high-volume chat threads
how_its_made:
WeMeetAI is an AI-powered networking assistant that helps users manage and recall conversations during and after events effortlessly. Instead of sifting through scattered, unstructured messages, users receive clean, organized summaries of every meaningful interaction.

Key features include:
Simple Connection – Instantly connect with other attendees through shared group chats, no need to exchange contact details manually.
AI Summarization – Our AI captures the essence of each conversation—No more endless scrolling. Just instant clarity.
AI Agent Workflows - WeMeetAI assistant helps you manage workflows needed to convert lead to conversions. 
Analytics - Detailed retrospective of your networking activity
Schedule calls, meetings, and everything needed to create value.

Built using OASIS protocol.
